content.short: Omniscia.io offers security audits, gas-cost optimization, and development services for decentralized networks and apps.
content.description: Omniscia.io partners with startups and enterprises to design, build, and secure complex decentralized networks and applications. The team conducts line-by-line security audits, optimizes code to reduce gas costs, and offers curated development services for features frequently requested in real-world projects, including DEX integrations, advanced ERC20 tokens, and bonding curves. Their client roster spans Ava Labs, Polygon, DappRadar, L’Oréal, Aavegotchi, and other notable projects across the blockchain ecosystem.
